summary: Connected Windows Members and Viewers can log out from the board. The Kit button calls EditClient::logout off the frame thread; the host's revoke operation deletes only the presented session. A failed request leaves the board available for explicit retry. An acknowledgment returns the same window to empty identifier entry without reusing the launch configuration.
evidence: configured_logout_failure_then_retry: the child-only TCP relay dropped one connection before opening an upstream socket. The window showed Could not log out, Log out and both Review labels. Fresh database connections found IDs 42 then 17 at revision 1 and both original Member session links; the peer could still read directly from the host.

Restoring the same route let the window submit ' Jade ' once without signing in again. The labels, peer read and database agreed on Review/1 above Jade/2, with both sessions intact. Explicit logout then showed an empty identifier and Next with no password, board, editor or logout action and no second load. Only the peer verifier remained; the peer resolved and read, while the original session was rejected on resolve, read and rename. A fresh child with the unchanged launch pair showed Session expired and the same clean sign-in controls. Neither row nor the peer changed.

interactive_viewer_logs_out: a subscribed Viewer signed in through identifier, Next, masked password and Sign in, and saw both Review rows in order under Board items · Read only. After a peer login, explicit logout returned to empty identifier entry and only the peer remained usable. Signing in again in the same window showed the read-only board with no editor or submission. Fresh reads found both rows still at revision 1, the original peer and a new Viewer verifier, with the logged-out verifier absent.

The initial configured smoke run timed out; the relay was corrected to use blocking I/O on the accepted Windows socket. The focused rerun passed, followed by all 11 windows_smoke cases passing serially in graphical Windows processes. Each new case used its own disposable schema and a connected child without database or local actor configuration.

All five loopback_board_access tests passed, including explicit_logout_isolates_sessions, member_edits_within_scope and viewer_reads_but_cannot_rename. cargo test --locked --workspace passed all 19 tests. cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed.

The shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs, so the Node runner regressions await coordinator verification. No fresh reference comparison was run. Broader account-menu, concurrent-window and lost-acknowledgment UI parity remain open.
